expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the headline and the supporting line ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are rendered in white on a very light mint-green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer text is barely readable.
The subtext in the promo banner is even lower contrast than the headline because it is smaller, lighter-weight white text on the same pale background, compounding the readability problem.

The 'Fastest near you' carousel thumbnails are visually inconsistent: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light gray/white background while the other cards use dark blurred backgrounds, making the row look uneven.

expected.reasoning: Both reports describe low-contrast white text in the promo banner against its pale background.
